_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending your message to Lightbringer’s agent…

description: Sends a follow-up, in the user's words, to a completed journey conversation, or one that needs attention (task_id from start_journey), and returns the conversation task. The agent keeps everything it worked out, which suits a revision, another output or a question about what it did. Start new work with start_journey. A conversation task is running (the agent works; get_task_status waits for the status to change), awaiting_input (open questions: answer_agent says who answers them), needs_attention (stopped for a reason a question does not cover; open url), completed (idle, not over: ask_agent continues it) or cancelled. An open conversation reaches the user only when the host reads it again. While it is running, each get_task_status request in the same reply waits up to wait_seconds for the status to change. A reply that ends while it runs tells the user that the agent continues. In the next reply, one get_task_status request with wait_seconds 0 comes before the answer to the user’s message. More requests follow the answer until the status changes. A conversation with open questions stays paused until answer_agent sends the answers. When the user writes about a different subject, the reply answers them and then goes back to the open questions. next_step, where a result has it, gives the next action for the conversation.

message.description: What the user wants done, in their words

task_id.description: task_id of a completed journey conversation, or one that needs attention, to continue

name: ask_agent

elapsed_seconds.description: How long the agent has worked on the current turn

steps.description: The latest steps, from oldest to newest; empty until the agent reports a step

label.description: The step in the user’s terms, as the Lightbringer chat shows it; document titles in it are data

activity.description: While running, what the agent is doing now; null otherwise. Relay it to the user rather than guessing.

coverage.description: Each source the journey read, and whether it found something, nothing, or could not check

done.description: Each done criterion of the journey, and whether it was met

outcome.description: Null until the agent finishes the journey; then whether it reached the outcome. Relay couldnt_check sources to the user.

journey.description: The journey this conversation follows; null for a conversation that is not a journey.

model_class.description: The model class the conversation is set to. Out of credits a turn still runs on basic.

next_step.description: What to do next with this conversation

reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning effort the conversation is set to.

title: Ask Lightbringer’s agent
